FRESH_REMOTE_ZONETYPE=True

IAS Zone devices may preserve Zigbee network membership across reboot while volatile IAS enrollment/CIE runtime state is lost. For an already-known IAS endpoint, `DEVICE_REJOIN` therefore refreshes the coordinator IAS CIE address even when the device keeps the same 16-bit short address and normal endpoint discovery remains claimed for that route. The CIE write is queued through the existing bounded discovery worker, never performed directly in the Zigbee callback.

This refresh is deliberately narrower than full rediscovery: IEEE identity, cached endpoint metadata, and same-route discovery state remain valid. The remote CIE write re-establishes the standard enrollment/notification path; subsequent IAS ZoneStatus notifications remain authoritative for normalized `CONTACT_OPEN` state. Factory-new storage erase is not part of normal rejoin recovery.

The emulator models restore notifications with the IAS `RestoreNotify` bit held at `0x0020` while `Alarm1` toggles, yielding `0x0020` / `0x0021`. This is test-peer behavior used to exercise both closed/restore and open/alarm notifications without the rejected generic ZoneStatus reporting path.

'''
